name: tasks
description: A to-do API with CRUD, a completion action, filtering, bearer auth and offset pagination.

input.title: Task API
input.requirements: A to-do list service. A task has a title (required, up to 200 characters), a done flag (false when created), an optional due_date (a date) and a server-generated id (UUID). Users can list tasks (filterable by done), create a task, fetch one, update any of title, done or due_date, delete one, and mark a task as complete with one call.
